name: Scheduled: Fast5 for Compliance — Weekly Digest
description:
# Fast5 for Compliance — Weekly Digest

Automated weekly analysis of **compliance / KYC calls** from Gong (via Salesforce), posted as a structured digest to Slack for the Compliance team.

> 📋 **Monday ticket:** [Compliance Call Analysis Automation via Workato](https://brightdata-group.monday.com/boards/18389886720/views/224786496/pulses/12658994494)

---

## 🎯 What it does
Every Monday, this recipe:
1. Pulls the previous week's compliance calls from Salesforce (`Gong__Gong_Call__c`)
2. Classifies them (HELD vs no-show) and segments by company size (SMB+ / Micro)
3. Analyzes each held call with Claude (Anthropic) across 8 compliance questions
4. Aggregates counts + evidence and posts a validated digest to Slack

---

## 📊 What it reports
**Volume counts**
- SMB+ calls / week
- Micro calls / week
- No-shows (scheduled, customer didn't attend)

**Per-call analysis (held calls)**
- Reason for the call
- Form discrepancies
- Missing documents
- Complex / unclear cases
- Platform demo needed?
- Screen sharing used?
- Residential-proxy justification
- Special permissions discussed?

**Extras:** clickable links to each Salesforce Account/Lead + 🎧 direct link to the Gong recording, evidence examples per issue, and a per-call matrix.

---

## 🔧 How it works
| Phase | Description |
|---|---|
| **Trigger** | Weekly scheduler (Mon 07:00) |
| **Collect** | Salesforce SOQL — compliance calls identified by Compliance tracker, `compliance_kyc@brightdata.com`, or call title |
| **Normalize** | Ruby — HELD/no-show classification, residential/compliance signals, internal-call exclusion |
| **Segment** | 3-tier: `Account.Company_Type__c` → `Lead.Company_Type_list__c` → `Hubspot_Company_Type__c` |
| **Analyze** | Claude (Sonnet), batched — the 8 questions → structured JSON |
| **Report** | Ruby — counts, evidence, Slack Block Kit, validation |
| **Publish** | Slack `chat.postMessage` (only if validation passes) |

---

## 🔌 Connections
- **Salesforce** (OAuth2) — source data
- **Anthropic (Claude)** — call analysis
- **Slack** — digest output

---

## ⚙️ Config
| Field | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `compliance_email` | Compliance mailbox for call identification |
| `compliance_title` | Call-title keyword for identification |
| `slack_channel` | Target channel (#compliance-weekly-insights) |
| `sf_base` | Salesforce Lightning base URL (for record links) |

---

## 🛡️ Safeguards
- **0-calls guard** — posts "no calls this week" and stops
- **Slack limits enforced** — ≤50 blocks, ≤3000 chars/block (auto-truncation)
- **Validation gate** — report only posts if valid; otherwise stops (no broken report)
- **Scale-safe** — chunked Lead queries (200/batch), batched LLM calls

---

## 📝 Notes
- **SFDC-only** (v1) — no Gong API dependency
- KYC/compliance reported as a **combined** signal (Gong API would be needed for the kyc-vs-compliance split)
- Segmentation "Unknown" only when no company-type data exists on Account or Lead

---

require 'json'
require 'cgi'

compliance_email = input["compliance_email"].to_s.downcase
compliance_title = input["compliance_title"].to_s

def html_to_text(s)
  return "" if s.nil? || s.to_s.strip.empty?
  t = s.to_s.gsub(/<br\s*\/?>/i, "\n").gsub(/<\/?[^>]+>/, "")
  CGI.unescapeHTML(t).gsub(/[ \t]+\n/, "\n").strip
end

def safe_json(s)
  return [] if s.nil? || s.to_s.strip.empty?
  JSON.parse(s) rescue []
end

calls      = input["calls"] || []
normalized = []
lead_ids   = []

calls.each do |c|
  trackers = safe_json(c["Gong__Related_Trackers_json__c"])
  topics   = safe_json(c["Gong__Related_Topics_json__c"])
  parts    = safe_json(c["Gong__Related_Participants_json__c"])
  leads    = safe_json(c["Gong__Related_Leads_json__c"])

  # --- Account company type (from Query A related object) ---
  acct = c["Gong__Primary_Account__r"]
  account_company_type =
    if acct.is_a?(Hash)
      acct["Company_Type__c"]
    else
      # fallback if connector flattens the related field
      c["Gong__Primary_Account__r_Company_Type__c"] || c["Gong__Primary_Account__r.Company_Type__c"]
    end
   account_id = c["Gong__Primary_Account__c"]   # the Account ID (for SF link)


  comp = trackers.find { |t| t["Name"].to_s.casecmp("Compliance").zero? }
  compliance_total = comp ? comp["Gong__Tracker_Occurrences__c"].to_i : 0

  emails = c["Gong__Participants_Emails__c"].to_s.downcase
  title  = c["Gong__Title__c"].to_s
  is_compliance = compliance_total > 0 ||
                  (!compliance_email.empty? && emails.include?(compliance_email)) ||
                  (!compliance_title.empty? && title.include?(compliance_title))
  next unless is_compliance

  # --- external participant + lead id ---
  external = parts.find { |p| p["Gong__Affiliation__c"] == "External" }
  lead_id  = (external && external["Gong__Lead_Participant__c"]) ||
             (leads.first && leads.first["Gong__Related_Entity_ID__c"])

  ext_email  = external && external["Gong__Participant_Email__c"].to_s.downcase
  ext_domain = ext_email && ext_email.include?("@") ? ext_email.split("@").last : nil

  # --- internal-only detection ---
  has_external = !external.nil? && ext_email && !ext_email.end_with?("@brightdata.com")
  is_internal_only = !has_external

  # --- content ---
  brief      = html_to_text(c["Gong__Call_Brief__c"])
  key_points = html_to_text(c["Gong__Call_Key_Points__c"])
  next_steps = html_to_text(c["Gong__Call_Highlights_Next_Steps__c"])
  has_content = !brief.empty? || !key_points.empty?

  # --- no-show logic: held if real duration AND real content ---
  dur    = c["Gong__Call_Duration_sec__c"].to_i
  held   = dur >= 120 && has_content
  status = held ? "HELD" : "NO_SHOW"

  # --- residential ---
  residential_hits = trackers
    .select { |t| t["Name"] == "BD products - Proxy" && t["Gong__Tracker_Phrase__c"] == "residential" }
    .sum { |t| t["Gong__Tracker_Occurrences__c"].to_i }

  url = c["Gong__View_call__c"].to_s[/href="([^"]+)"/, 1] ||
        "https://app.gong.io/call?id=#{c['Gong__Call_ID__c']}"


  normalized << {
    "id"                  => c["Id"],
    "gongCallId"          => c["Gong__Call_ID__c"],
    "title"               => (title.empty? ? c["Name"] : title),
    "url"                 => url,
    "scheduled"           => c["Gong__scheduled__c"],
    "durationSec"         => dur,
    "status"              => status,
    "isInternalOnly"      => is_internal_only,
    "leadId"              => lead_id,
    "externalEmail"       => ext_email,
    "emailDomain"         => ext_domain,
    "externalName"        => external && external["Gong__Full_Name_Temp__c"],
    "accountCompanyType"  => account_company_type,   # NEW,
    "accountId"           => account_id, 
    "complianceTotal"     => compliance_total,
    "residentialHits"     => residential_hits,
    "brief"               => brief,
    "keyPoints"           => key_points,
    "nextSteps"           => next_steps
  }
end

customer = normalized.reject { |n| n["isInternalOnly"] }

uniq_lead_ids = lead_ids.compact.uniq

# --- build SFDC-safe chunks (200 ids each) for the Lead query loop ---
chunk_size = 200
chunks = uniq_lead_ids.each_slice(chunk_size).map do |slice|
  { "formatted" => slice.map { |i| "'#{i}'" }.join(",") }
end
chunks = [{ "formatted" => "'000000000000000'" }] if chunks.empty?  # never emit empty IN()

lead_ids_formatted = uniq_lead_ids.empty? ? "'000000000000000'" : uniq_lead_ids.map { |i| "'#{i}'" }.join(",")

{
  "normalized_calls"   => normalized,
  "customer_calls"     => customer,
  "lead_ids"           => uniq_lead_ids,
  "lead_ids_formatted" => lead_ids_formatted,
  "lead_id_chunks"     => chunks,
  "chunk_count"        => chunks.length,
  "customer_count"     => customer.length,                           # NEW — for 0-calls guard
  "held_count"         => customer.count { |n| n["status"] == "HELD" },
  "noshow_count"       => customer.count { |n| n["status"] == "NO_SHOW" },
  "internal_count"     => normalized.count { |n| n["isInternalOnly"] }
}

customer_calls = input["customer_calls"] || []
leads          = input["leads"] || []

lead_map = {}
leads.each { |l| lead_map[l["Id"]] = l }

def to_segment(t)
  return "Unknown" if t.nil? || t.to_s.strip.empty?
  t.to_s.strip.casecmp("Micro-Business").zero? ? "Micro" : "SMB+"
end

# Lead type: formula field first, then HubSpot field
def lead_type(lead)
  return nil unless lead
  t1 = lead["Company_Type_list__c"]
  return t1 if t1 && !t1.to_s.strip.empty?
  t2 = lead["Hubspot_Company_Type__c"]
  return t2 if t2 && !t2.to_s.strip.empty?
  nil
end

# ---- segment ----
segmented = customer_calls.map do |c|
  acct_type = c["accountCompanyType"]
  lead      = c["leadId"] ? lead_map[c["leadId"]] : nil
  ltype     = lead_type(lead)

  ctype =
    if acct_type && !acct_type.to_s.strip.empty? then acct_type
    elsif ltype && !ltype.to_s.strip.empty? then ltype
    else nil end

  c.merge({
    "companyType" => (ctype || "Unknown"),
    "segment"     => to_segment(ctype),
    "company"     => (lead && lead["Company"]) || c["externalName"],
    "industry"    => (lead && lead["Industry"])
  })
end

# ---- build LLM batches (HELD calls only, groups of 5) ----
held = segmented.select { |c| c["status"] == "HELD" }
slim = held.map do |c|
  {
    "gongCallId"      => c["gongCallId"],
    "company"         => c["company"],
    "segment"         => c["segment"],
    "residentialHits" => c["residentialHits"],
    "brief"           => c["brief"],
    "keyPoints"       => c["keyPoints"],
    "nextSteps"       => c["nextSteps"]
  }
end
batches = slim.each_slice(15).map.with_index do |group, i|
  { "batch_index" => i, "calls_json" => group.to_json }
end
batches = [{ "batch_index" => 0, "calls_json" => "[]" }] if batches.empty?

{
  "segmented_calls" => segmented,
  "batches"         => batches,
  "batch_count"     => batches.length,
  "held_total"      => held.length,
  "smbplus_total"   => segmented.count { |c| c["segment"]=="SMB+" },
  "micro_total"     => segmented.count { |c| c["segment"]=="Micro" },
  "unknown_total"   => segmented.count { |c| c["segment"]=="Unknown" },
  "smbplus_held"    => segmented.count { |c| c["segment"]=="SMB+"  && c["status"]=="HELD" },
  "micro_held"      => segmented.count { |c| c["segment"]=="Micro" && c["status"]=="HELD" },
  "unknown_held"    => segmented.count { |c| c["segment"]=="Unknown" && c["status"]=="HELD" },
  "smbplus_noshow"  => segmented.count { |c| c["segment"]=="SMB+"  && c["status"]=="NO_SHOW" },
  "micro_noshow"    => segmented.count { |c| c["segment"]=="Micro" && c["status"]=="NO_SHOW" }
}

block.description: Sends a message to Claude Sonnet 4.5 in Anthropic

input.system: You are a compliance-call analyst for Bright Data. Extract structured facts ONLY from the provided Gong call summaries. If something is not stated, use null or false — never guess. Keep every string under 20 words. Translate any non-English text to English. Return ONLY a valid JSON array — no prose, no explanations, no markdown code fences.

messages.message:
Analyze EACH compliance/KYC call below. Return ONLY a JSON array. Each element must have these exact keys:

{
  "gongCallId": "<copy exactly from the call's gongCallId>",
  "reason": "why this call happened (short)",
  "formDiscrepancies": {"found": true/false, "detail": "short phrase or null"},
  "missingDocuments": {"found": true/false, "items": ["document names"]},
  "complexCase": {"found": true/false, "detail": "short phrase or null"},
  "demoNeeded": true/false,
  "screenSharingUsed": true/false,
  "residentialProxyJustification": {"explained": true/false, "reason": "short phrase or null"},
  "specialPermissionsDiscussed": {"found": true/false, "detail": "short phrase or null"}
}

Definitions:
- formDiscrepancies: mismatch between submitted KYC form info and reality (e.g. wrong company/entity).
- missingDocuments: docs Bright Data asked the customer to provide (incorporation cert, ID, proof, etc.).
- complexCase: unusual/unclear situation needing extra review or escalation.
- demoNeeded: did Bright Data request or was there a product/workflow demo?
- screenSharingUsed: did the customer share their screen?
- residentialProxyJustification: did the customer explain WHY they need residential proxies?
- specialPermissionsDiscussed: government-domain whitelisting, password-typing, or other special access.

Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact shape:
{ "results": [ { ...call analysis... }, { ...call analysis... } ] }

{

    {
      "gongCallId": "877805275048889469",

      "residentialProxyJustification": { "explained": true, "reason": "cost/efficiency" },
      "specialPermissionsDiscussed": { "found": true, "detail": "gated behind KYC" }
    }
  ]
}

input.code:
require 'json'

calls    = input["segmented_calls"] || []
analysis = input["analysis"] || []
week_label    = input["week_label"].to_s
timestamp     = input["timestamp"].to_s
slack_channel = input["slack_channel"].to_s
sf_base       = input["sf_base"].to_s.sub(/\/+\z/, "")   # NEW — strip trailing slash

# ---- merge ----
amap = {}
analysis.each { |a| amap[a["gongCallId"]] = a }
merged = calls.map { |c| c.merge({ "analysis" => (amap[c["gongCallId"]] || {}) }) }

held   = merged.select { |c| c["status"] == "HELD" }
noshow = merged.select { |c| c["status"] == "NO_SHOW" }

def yes(c, *keys)
  v = c["analysis"] || {}
  keys.each { |k| v = v.is_a?(Hash) ? v[k] : nil }
  !!v
end

def name_of(c)
  n = c["company"].to_s.strip
  n = c["externalName"].to_s.strip if n.empty?
  n = c["externalEmail"].to_s.strip if n.empty?
  n = "(unknown)" if n.empty?
  n
end

# ---- counts ----
smbplus = merged.count { |c| c["segment"]=="SMB+" }
micro   = merged.count { |c| c["segment"]=="Micro" }
unknown = merged.count { |c| c["segment"]=="Unknown" }
total   = smbplus + micro + unknown
smbplus_held = held.count { |c| c["segment"]=="SMB+" }
micro_held   = held.count { |c| c["segment"]=="Micro" }
smbplus_ns   = noshow.count { |c| c["segment"]=="SMB+" }
micro_ns     = noshow.count { |c| c["segment"]=="Micro" }
held_tot     = held.length
noshow_tot   = noshow.length

# ---- rollups ----
demo    = held.count { |c| yes(c,"demoNeeded") }
screen  = held.count { |c| yes(c,"screenSharingUsed") }
res_exp = held.count { |c| yes(c,"residentialProxyJustification","explained") }
special = held.count { |c| yes(c,"specialPermissionsDiscussed","found") }
discrep = held.count { |c| yes(c,"formDiscrepancies","found") }
missing = held.count { |c| yes(c,"missingDocuments","found") }
complex = held.count { |c| yes(c,"complexCase","found") }
res_calls = held.count { |c| c["residentialHits"].to_i > 0 }

items = held.flat_map { |c| (c.dig("analysis","missingDocuments","items") || []) }
missing_items = items.each_with_object(Hash.new(0)) { |i,h| h[i]+=1 }
                     .sort_by { |_,n| -n }.first(8).map { |k,v| { "item"=>k, "count"=>v } }

pct = ->(n){ held_tot > 0 ? (100.0 * n / held_tot).round : 0 }

# ---- TL;DR + watch ----
tldr = "#{total} compliance calls this week — #{smbplus} SMB+, #{micro} Micro, #{noshow_tot} no-show. " \
       "Residential-proxy justification appeared in #{pct.call(res_exp)}% of held calls; " \
       "missing documents were the top friction (#{pct.call(missing)}%)."
watch = []
watch << "Government-domain / special-permission requests in #{special} calls" if special > 0
watch << "KYC form discrepancies flagged in #{discrep} calls" if discrep > 0
watch << "#{complex} complex/unclear cases needing extra review" if complex > 0
watch << "#{noshow_tot} scheduled call(s) with no customer show" if noshow_tot > 0
watch = ["No notable patterns this week"] if watch.empty?

# ---- segment table ----
counts_table = "Segment    | Calls | Held | No-show\n" \
               "-----------+-------+------+--------\n" \
               "SMB+       | #{smbplus.to_s.ljust(5)} | #{smbplus_held.to_s.ljust(4)} | #{smbplus_ns}\n" \
               "Micro      | #{micro.to_s.ljust(5)} | #{micro_held.to_s.ljust(4)} | #{micro_ns}\n" \
               "-----------+-------+------+--------\n" \
               "Total      | #{total.to_s.ljust(5)} | #{held_tot.to_s.ljust(4)} | #{noshow_tot}"

# ---- per-call matrix (plain — no links in code block) ----
def yn(c,*k); v=c["analysis"]||{}; k.each{|x| v=v.is_a?(Hash) ? v[x]: nil}; v ? "Y" : "-"; end
header_row = "#{'Company'.ljust(20)} #{'Seg'.ljust(5)} Dm Sc Dc Di Cx\n"
rows = held.map do |c|
  seg = c["segment"]=="SMB+" ? "SMB+" : "Micro"
  nm  = name_of(c); nm = nm.length>20 ? nm[0,19]+"…" : nm.ljust(20)
  "#{nm} #{seg.ljust(5)} #{yn(c,'demoNeeded')}  #{yn(c,'screenSharingUsed')}  #{yn(c,'missingDocuments','found')}  #{yn(c,'formDiscrepancies','found')}  #{yn(c,'complexCase','found')}"
end
per_call = header_row + rows.join("\n")
if per_call.length > 2850
  while per_call.length > 2800 && !rows.empty?; rows.pop; end
  per_call = header_row + rows.join("\n") + "\n… +#{held.length - rows.length} more"
end

# ---- LINKED evidence helpers ----
def clip(s, n=90); s = s.to_s.strip; s.empty? ? nil : (s.length>n ? s[0,n-1]+"…" : s); end

def linked_name(c, base)
  nm     = name_of(c)
  acct   = c["accountId"].to_s
  lead   = c["leadId"].to_s
  gong   = c["url"].to_s
  rec_id = acct.empty? ? lead : acct   # prefer Account, else Lead
  name_part = (!base.empty? && !rec_id.empty?) ? "<#{base}/#{rec_id}|#{nm}>" : nm
  gong_part = gong.empty? ? "" : " <#{gong}|🎧>"
  "#{name_part}#{gong_part}"
end

def evidence(held, base, detail_proc, max=3)
  held.map { |c| d = detail_proc.call(c); d ? "• #{linked_name(c, base)} — #{d}" : nil }.compact.first(max)
end

disc_ev = evidence(held, sf_base, ->(c){ a=c.dig("analysis","formDiscrepancies"); (a && a["found"]) ? clip(a["detail"]) : nil })
miss_ev = evidence(held, sf_base, ->(c){ a=c.dig("analysis","missingDocuments"); (a && a["found"] && (a["items"]||[]).any?) ? clip((a["items"]||[]).join(", ")) : nil })
cplx_ev = evidence(held, sf_base, ->(c){ a=c.dig("analysis","complexCase"); (a && a["found"]) ? clip(a["detail"]) : nil })
perm_ev = evidence(held, sf_base, ->(c){ a=c.dig("analysis","specialPermissionsDiscussed"); (a && a["found"]) ? clip(a["detail"]) : nil })
res_ev  = evidence(held, sf_base, ->(c){ a=c.dig("analysis","residentialProxyJustification"); (a && a["explained"]) ? clip(a["reason"]) : nil })

# ---- block builders ----
def sec(t); { "type"=>"section", "text"=>{ "type"=>"mrkdwn", "text"=>t.to_s[0,2990] } }; end
def ctx(t); { "type"=>"context", "elements"=>[ { "type"=>"mrkdwn", "text"=>t.to_s[0,2990] } ] }; end
def hdr(t); { "type"=>"header", "text"=>{ "type"=>"plain_text", "text"=>t.to_s[0,150], "emoji"=>true } }; end
def div; { "type"=>"divider" }; end
secl = ->(t){ sec(t) }
def ev_section(title, count, held_tot, lines, sec_lambda)
  return nil if lines.empty?
  sec_lambda.call(title + " (#{count} of #{held_tot})\n" + lines.join("\n"))
end

# ---- build blocks ----
b = []
b << hdr("🛡️ Weekly Compliance Call Insights")
b << ctx("Based on *#{total}* compliance calls reviewed (`#{week_label}`) — for the Compliance Team.")
b << div
b << sec(":dart: *TL;DR:* #{tldr}")
b << sec("```\n#{counts_table}\n```")
b << div
b << sec(":mag: *Call analysis (#{held_tot} held)*\n" \
         ":handshake: Demo needed: *#{demo}*  ·  :desktop_computer: Screen shared: *#{screen}*\n" \
         ":globe_with_meridians: Residential justified: *#{res_exp}* / #{res_calls}  ·  :closed_lock_with_key: Special permissions: *#{special}*\n" \
         ":warning: Discrepancies: *#{discrep}*  ·  :page_facing_up: Missing docs: *#{missing}*  ·  :jigsaw: Complex: *#{complex}*")
b << div
s = ev_section(":warning: *Form discrepancies*", discrep, held_tot, disc_ev, secl); b << s if s
s = ev_section(":page_facing_up: *Missing documents*", missing, held_tot, miss_ev, secl); b << s if s
s = ev_section(":jigsaw: *Complex / unclear cases*", complex, held_tot, cplx_ev, secl); b << s if s
s = ev_section(":closed_lock_with_key: *Special permissions*", special, held_tot, perm_ev, secl); b << s if s
s = ev_section(":globe_with_meridians: *Residential-proxy justifications*", res_exp, held_tot, res_ev, secl); b << s if s
b << div
b << sec(":eyes: *Watch:*\n" + watch.map{|w| "• #{w}"}.join("\n"))
b << div
b << sec(":clipboard: *Per-call matrix*\n_Dm=Demo  Sc=Screen  Dc=Docs  Di=Discrepancy  Cx=Complex_\n```\n#{per_call}\n```")
b << div
b << ctx("_Generated by BrightMind 🤖 · #{total} calls · #{held_tot} analyzed · #{timestamp}_\n:speech_balloon: Want a different format or extra fields? Reply in this thread and we'll adjust.")
b = b[0,50]

# ---- validation ----
errors = []; warnings = []
errors << "Too many blocks (#{b.size} > 50)" if b.size > 50
b.each_with_index do |blk,i|
  txt = blk.dig("text","text") || (blk["elements"] ? blk["elements"][0]["text"] : "") || ""
  errors << "Block ##{i} exceeds 3000 chars (#{txt.length})" if txt.length > 3000
end
errors   << "No calls found" if total == 0
warnings << "Analysis incomplete: #{amap.length} vs #{held_tot} held" if amap.length < held_tot
warnings << "Unknown segments present (#{unknown})" if unknown > 0
is_valid  = errors.empty?
max_chars = b.map { |blk| (blk.dig("text","text") || (blk["elements"] ? blk["elements"][0]["text"] : "") || "").length }.max
validation = { "valid"=>is_valid, "errors"=>errors, "warnings"=>warnings, "block_count"=>b.size, "max_block_chars"=>max_chars }

# ---- slack body ----
slack_body = { "channel"=>slack_channel, "blocks"=>b, "unfurl_links"=>false, "unfurl_media"=>false }

{
  "analyzed_calls" => merged,
  "smbplus_total"=>smbplus, "micro_total"=>micro, "unknown_total"=>unknown,
  "held_total"=>held_tot, "noshow_total"=>noshow_tot,
  "demoNeeded"=>demo, "screenShare"=>screen,
  "residentialExplained"=>res_exp, "residentialCalls"=>res_calls,
  "specialPerms"=>special, "discrepancies"=>discrep,
  "missingDocs"=>missing, "complexCases"=>complex,
  "tldr"=>tldr,
  "blocks"=>b,
  "block_count"=>b.size,
  "valid"=>is_valid,
  "validation"=>validation.to_json,
  "errors_str"=>errors.join(" | "),
  "slack_body_json"=>slack_body.to_json
}
